name: O. Moroz
evidence: Identified as Oksana Vladimirovna Moroz, PhD in cultural studies, associate professor in HSE University's Media department (also teaches at MSSES), co-author of this row's paper. WebSearch returned her HSE, MSSES, PostNauka, Individuum and Substack pages; none of the retrieved text contained an address. Her Google Scholar profile only shows a 'verified email at hse.ru' badge, which the brief explicitly says is not an address. GitHub code search for '"Oksana Moroz" "@" in:file' returned only synthetic fixture data (example.com rows in a workshop repo), a Ukrainian blogger of the same name in a Wikidata dump, and an unrelated JS-course package.json - all excluded by the namesake rule.
